three_js.description: Dynamic kinetic lines shooting across the scene like speed lines. Bold and high energy. Lines fade quickly. Pulse syncs to a rhythm.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Exercise has many Sets — each with reps, weight, duration, or distance
PersonalRecord belongs to User per Exercise — auto-updated when beaten
BodyMetric belongs to User — weight, measurements, body fat tracked over time
Program belongs to User or is a template — contains a schedule of Workouts
Goal belongs to User — target weight, PR, or streak
Streak belongs to User — consecutive workout days

layout.notes: During active workout on iPhone — hide all navigation. Full screen, only exercise name, sets, timer, and finish button. No distractions. On iPad and desktop — active workout shows in main panel, exercise list remains accessible in sidebar.

avoid: Never use small tap targets during active workout — minimum 56px for all workout logging actions
Never require more than 2 taps to log a set during active workout
Never auto-advance to next exercise without user confirmation
Never use subtle colours for active workout UI — high contrast only
Never show social content during active workout — dedicated focused mode
Never lose workout data on app close or phone lock — always persist in-progress workout
Never fabricate personal records — only show PR badge when genuinely beaten
Never show calorie counts as the primary metric — they are secondary to performance
enforce: Active workout mode: full screen, no distractions, workout controls only
Rest timer starts automatically after set logged — user can dismiss or extend
Previous performance shown above input fields for each exercise — instant reference
PR badge animates on screen when personal record beaten — celebratory moment
Workout always auto-saved every 30 seconds — never lose data
Exercise weight increment buttons — +2.5kg and -2.5kg — large tap targets
Set logged haptic feedback — subtle but immediate confirmation
Workout duration timer always visible during active session

empty_states.ui: Start workout prompt centred. Quick start options: 'Upper body / Lower body / Full body / Custom'. No empty stats — hide stats section until first workout completed.
Calendar shows current month with no activity. Message: 'Complete your first workout to see your history'. CTA: 'Start workout'. Heat map hidden until data exists.
Trophy illustration. Message: 'Log your first workout to set your records'. Sub: 'Your personal bests will track here automatically'.

loading_states.ui: Streak badge loads from cache immediately. Recent workouts skeleton — 3 rows with exercise count and duration placeholder. Program progress skeleton if applicable.
Search field active immediately. Exercise list skeleton — 8 rows with name and muscle group badge placeholder. Filter chips visible.
Chart skeleton rectangle. Metric selector chips visible and active. Date range selector visible. Data loads into chart without full page reload.

error_flows.ui: Warning toast: 'Workout save failed'. Auto-retry in background. Local copy preserved. 'Sync when connected' indicator. Never lose the session data.
Search shows: 'No results for [query]'. CTA: 'Create custom exercise'. Suggested similar exercises shown below.
Heart rate shows last known value with 'Disconnected' label. Manual heart rate entry offered. Workout continues — wearable data is supplementary not blocking.
Local PR marked with sync pending icon. 'Will sync when connected' message. PR celebrated locally even before sync confirms.

edge_cases.case: User attempts to log 0 reps or 0 weight
edge_cases.ui: Inline validation: '0 reps cannot be logged'. Prompt to enter valid values. Never log empty sets.
Gentle check-in at 3h mark: 'Still working out?' with continue and finish options. Prevents accidental all-day timers.

edge_cases.case: Same exercise added twice to one workout
edge_cases.ui: Allow it — some programs use multiple sets of the same exercise with rest between. Show exercise twice with clear set numbering.

edge_cases.case: Rest timer interrupted by phone call
edge_cases.ui: Timer pauses during call. Resumes after call ends. Push notification: 'Your rest timer is paused'.
